fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Numerama's 2019 product article https://www.numerama.com/pop-culture/526602-cooperation-silencieuse-au-programme-de-nos-jeux-de-societe-de-la-semaine.html displays this full box image and credits it to Lifestyle Boardgames directly below the image. The publisher's own Narabi listing https://lifestyle-boardgames.com/games/narabi/ identifies the 2018 game, same illustrator, 3–5 players, and same language-neutral box. The image is press-hosted publisher-supplied artwork, not a search-result or retailer image. Reduced to 283 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player holding a stone marked 0 starts the cooperative game.
clarifications: A separate instruction gives the scoring card to the most responsible player; that does not determine the first turn.
